acceptanceCriteria: Resolved as the finding's Fix describes, with a regression test for any code change, or closed by an owner decision that rejects the finding.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: Unverified (low severity or beyond the per-reviewer cap; not examined by a verifier): - go-runtime:cmd: help text labels Core verbs experimental/alpha/Go-only (`cmd/corvint/help.go:218`); unknown flag reported as "unrecognized arguments" (`taskcontext.go:39`); adapter stdout write and CPU-profile close errors ignored (`host_adapter.go:852`); empty `--root` resolves to cwd (`main.go:642`). - go-runtime:kernel: contextindex kills the Git process group after Wait (PID-reuse hazard gokernel already fixed, `internal/contextindex/git.go:229`); snapshot eviction uses an unstable sort on tied mtimes (`snapshot.go:455`). - git-integrity: repo-owned `core.bigFileThreshold` steers range impact into a binary refusal (`range_impact.go:471`); symlink entries indexed as source with link target as content (`git.go:392`). - proof-soundness: `ciMapHeader` returns nil on unparseable JSON (`interop/cem01-go/ci.go:194`, V1-0133); `validateSpan` message promises start>=0 but checks end>=1 (`wire/map.go:302`). - red-team: corvint-mcp returns repository-authored text unframed in `structuredContent` (`cmd/corvint-mcp/main.go:223`). - wire-contract: mixed snake_case/camelCase key conventions frozen; `affected` unknowns as `CODE: detail` strings; experimental profiles frozen as wire identifiers. - retrieval: medium, Swift `impact` returns only the changed path with `git diff --check` as the only verification (`impact.go:150`); PPR off by default (`ppr.go:11`); lexical reason strings show inconsistent idf (`taskcontext.go:1108`). - rts: medium, impact ranks tests below every non-test importer so direct tests fall outside the limit (`impact.go:196`, V1-0263 root cause); V1-0264 appears fixed in code but is still OPEN (`internal/dogfoodflow/flow.go:399`). - admission: orientation receipt has no binary identity (`use-case-conformance-v0.md:50`); V1-0011 and V1-0184 OPEN after promotion. - agent-systems: `frontier-authority-unavailable` hard-coded on every receipt (`local_completion_event.go:471`); `adapter claude-source-handoff` labelled Core but experimental and file-writing (1.0 spec:113); compatibility tuple timeout disagrees with hooks.json; corvint-mcp answers standard `initialize` with -32601 unless the legacy flag is set (`internal/mcp/server/server.go:211`). - landscape: medium, no stable MCP surface in 1.0 Core (1.0 spec:60); Claude Code adapter README links a missing anchor.
title: panel: triage the unverified low-severity review items
